translation.name: Iwaperite tajorentsi ikenkithatakoetziri awinkatharite Jesokirishito: owakirari inimotakiri tajorentsi

content: Okaate rantayiterini aapatziyariri Jesoshi

Noyemijantzinkarite, tema osheki ikaminthaaperoeyakaeni Tajorentsi. Rootaki nokowakaaperotantakimiri eero pantashitawo eerori oetarikapaeni, inta panteniri irira okaatzi ikowakayimiri. Eenirowa pañi, kameetha pijeeke riweshiryaawenantemiri: rootaki ikowakagaeyakiririni maawaeni aapatziyariri Jesoshi.

Eero pikimiteeyarini theenkantatsiri, omaanta paashini pikenkithashiryaagaeyapiinteni. Piyotaperotero ikowakaakimiri Tajorentsi: okameethaperotaki. Aririka pantapiintero iroka, monkaataka: iñaaperoeyemini Tajorentsi pikameethatzi.
Eero pikantakaaperota

Ikantakina Tajorentsi: “Piyotagaeyerini oroomajatzi”, rootaki nokamananteeyimirorini iroka. Eero pikantakaaperota, eero piitashita panaakoeyakirini paashinipaeni pipinkatharitzi. Pikenkithashireeyaani tsika pikantari, piyoteeyeni imatakaaperotakimirika Tajorentsi paapatziyakari Jesoshi.
Pamine tsika akanteeyarini: eenitatsi oki aminantari, akempita akemantari, apaante añaawaetantari, ako oerikantari, aetzi anashitantari, maawaeni.
Eejatzi akimiteeyakarini maawaeni aapatziyeeyaririni Jesokirishito: akaateeyakini osheki, asheninkatawakagaeyakani. Omaanta inashitayitakani anteeyakirini.

Tema osheki ineshironkaeyakaeni maawaeni. Imatakagaeyakaeni antayitakironi oetarikapaeni, omaanta inashitayitakani. Eero aperawentawo antayiteroni. Aririka imatakaakimiro pikenkithatakayeri atziri, paapatziyaperotyaari kameetha pikenkithatakaantyaariri irira.
Aririka imatakaakimi petakotyaari paashinipaeni, ari pantero petakotyaari kameetha. Aririka imatakaakimi piyotaante, ari piyotaante kameetha.

Aririka imatakaakimi piweshiryaakayaari paashinipaeni, ari kameetha piweshiryaakagaeyaarini. Eejatzi aririka ikantemi pipashitatyaarini ashironkaenkari oetarikapaeni, pipaperoteri: eero pishampitsitzi. Aririka pamitakoteri paashinipaeni, eero piperatari, inta pishintsite pamitakoteri. Aririka pineshironkateri paashinipaeni, piweshireeyeeyani.

Pinintaperoeyerini paashinipaeni kameetha, eero pikantashitari: “Nonintakimi”, omaanta pinintaperoteri. Eero poejokirotawo kaari kameethatayitatsini, omaanta pikowaperote pantayiteroni kameethaperotatsiri.
Pinintaperotawakagaeyaani maawaeni: tema pikimitawakagaeyakani, paapatziyeeyarini Jesoshi. Pikowaperoeyeni pipinkathatawakagaeyani paashinipaeni.
Eero piperata, omaanta pikowaperoeyeni pishintsite panteniri Awinkatharite maawaeni ikowakagaeyemirini.

Piyoteeyakini imatakimiro Tajorentsi maawaeni ikantakimiri: iroñaaka piweshiryaawentyaawo. Aririka opomeentsitzimotemi oetarikapaeni, pimaeritakotashitawo inta pikanteri Tajorentsi: “Pamitakotena”. Tema okameethatzi pikantyaani pamaneri Tajorentsi.
Pipapiinteri piyemijantzinkarite koetyeemotariri. Paakameethatapiinteri ninkarika areetemini.
Pikanteri Tajorentsi ikamintheeyerini kijeeyakimirini, eero pipiyatari.
Aririka ikimoshiryaanaki atziri, pitsipatanakyaari pikimoshiryaaperotanaki eerori. Aririka rowashiretya atziri, aritaki pitsipatanakyaari powashiretya piweshiryaantanakya.
Paakameethatawakagaeyaani maawaeni atziripaeni. Eero pikantakaaperota inta paakameethateri owashironkaenkaripaeni pineshironkateri. Eero pikantzi: “Naaka yotzinkaripero”.
Aririka rantzimotemiro pisheninka kaari inimotzimi, eero pipiyatari. Kameetha pijeeke riyoteeyantemirini atziri pikameethataki.
Eero pipiyawaantetari paashinipaeni. Pikowaperoeyeni paakameethateeyerini paashinipaeni, maawaeni.

Noyemijantzinkarite, osheki nonintaperoeyakimini. Eero pipiyatari owashironkaawitemini. Rirokya Tajorentsi piyakowentemini. Tema paerani rojankinatakaantakironi Iwaperiteki, ikantakini: “Naaka piyawenteemini, naaka owashironkagaeyeririni. Tema naaka Piwinkatharite.
Aririka ayeri kijakimiri itashe, piperi rowanawo roya. Aririka imiritaki irira, pipakoteri imiri. Pantakirorika iroka, roojatzikya ipashiwenantanakya, eerokya rapiiteero ikijeemi eejatzi”.
Eero pathaagawo kaari kameethatayitatsini antakayemiro oetarikapaeni, omaantakya pikaminthayeri paashinipaeni, poñaayeri kameethatayitatsirini.
